tests.name: [F-01] a correctly signed payload crosses the gate unchanged

body.message: Please contact me about the product.

expect.why: a valid request dropped by the authentication node never reaches lead qualification or the sheet
the authentication gate must not rewrite the customer payload while checking its header

tests.name: [F-01] a wrong shared secret is refused
tests.why: accepting an invalid signature creates normal-looking rows from unauthorised callers

tests.name: [F-01] no configured secret fails closed
tests.why: a missing deployment variable must stop ingestion rather than silently disable authentication

tests.name: [F-02] a legitimate website field is not treated as a honeypot
tests.node: Spot the junk, with a reason

body.message: We need a quote for our automation project.

expect.why: website is a legitimate business field; treating it as a bot trap silently discards qualified leads
accepted leads must not carry a rejection reason that can cause a later router to divert them
the rejection audit and the accepted-lead row both depend on an ISO receipt timestamp

tests.name: [F-03] a phone-only call request remains a usable lead
tests.node: Spot the junk, with a reason

expect.why: a seven-or-more-digit phone number is a valid contact route even when the message is short and the email is unusable

tests.name: [F-04] a filled supported honeypot is rejected with an auditable reason
tests.node: Spot the junk, with a reason

body.message: This otherwise looks long enough to be accepted.

expect.why: if a configured honeypot stops working, automated submissions enter the main leads sheet with green executions
the rejected sheet needs the specific cause so a human can distinguish bots from contact-data failures

tests.name: [F-05] a disposable-email subdomain is rejected
tests.node: Spot the junk, with a reason

body.message: Please send full pricing and implementation details.

expect.why: checking only exact disposable domains lets their subdomains enter the accepted-lead branch
recording the matched domain makes a false positive diagnosable from the rejected sheet

tests.name: [F-06] three uppercase-scheme links trigger the first-contact limit
tests.node: Spot the junk, with a reason

body.message: Review HTTPS://one.example and HTTPS://two.example and HTTPS://three.example

expect.why: the first-contact contract allows at most two links; accepting three sends a link wall to the main leads sheet
the stored reason must state the observed count so the rejection can be reviewed

tests.name: [F-03] a submission with no usable contact route is rejected
tests.node: Spot the junk, with a reason

body.message: This message is long enough but nobody can reply to it.

expect.why: an unreachable submission otherwise creates a normal row that sales can never action

expect.value: no usable email address and no phone number
expect.why: the audit row must say that contact data, rather than content, caused the rejection

tests.name: [F-07] an Italian landline keeps its trunk zero

expect.why: for Italian landlines the zero is part of the callable international number; removing it stores a different number

tests.name: [F-08] a 0039 international number is not prefixed twice

expect.why: 0039 already carries a country code; adding the default prefix creates an uncallable +3939 number

tests.name: [F-09] compound and apostrophised names remain readable

expect.why: flattening a compound given name changes the contact name shown to sales and in replies
collapsing or mis-casing a multi-token surname makes duplicate review and customer-facing personalisation inconsistent
apostrophes must survive title-casing or the stored family name is visibly corrupted

tests.name: [F-10] a corporate email is normalised and classified by domain

expect.why: case and surrounding whitespace create duplicate contacts and failed exact-match lookups
the company-domain column drives account grouping and must be derived from the normalised address
a corporate address mislabelled as free mail changes downstream qualification and routing

tests.name: [F-10] Gmail is not presented as a company domain

expect.why: grouping Gmail contacts under a fictional Gmail account corrupts account-level reporting
free-mail contacts must not receive the business-email qualification flag

tests.name: [F-11] comments and utm_source aliases reach their canonical columns

expect.why: forms that send comments instead of message must not produce a blank sales note
losing utm_source silently attributes paid or partner leads to the generic web-form bucket

tests.name: [F-12] an upstream receipt timestamp is preserved

expect.why: replacing the ingestion time with a later node time changes response-time and ordering metrics

tests.name: [F-07] a number beyond the E.164 digit limit is not stored as callable

expect.why: storing more than 15 digits as an international phone number makes an invalid value look callable

tests.name: [F-13] spreadsheet control prefixes are neutralised
tests.node: Make it safe for a spreadsheet

expect.why: Google Sheets USER_ENTERED mode executes a leading equals sign as a formula
a leading plus can also be interpreted as a spreadsheet formula
a leading minus must be stored as text rather than evaluated input
a leading at-sign is part of the protected spreadsheet-control prefix set
neutralisation must not alter ordinary values while protecting dangerous ones

tests.name: [F-14] spreadsheet neutralisation reaches nested objects and arrays
tests.node: Make it safe for a spreadsheet

expect.why: an unprotected formula inside an object still reaches an auto-mapped spreadsheet column when the payload shape expands
array members require the same recursive protection as top-level strings
recursive traversal must preserve non-dangerous array values

tests.name: [F-15] rejected-lead logging keeps only the audit fields

input.message: sensitive message that does not belong in the rejected sheet

expect.why: the rejected sheet is an audit log, not a second copy of message and phone data, and its reason still needs formula protection

tests.name: [F-15] rejected email storage is bounded

expect.why: unbounded attacker-controlled email text can inflate the rejected sheet while every workflow execution remains green
